CONTRACT MIGRATION PROPOSAL (critical, frozen serializer): qmint.core.serialization.canonical_json leaks IssuerSecret bases/bits when the secret is nested inside an Any-typed field of a contract model (SecurityCertificate.parameters, BenchmarkRecord.configuration, TraceEvent.detail, IssuerSecret.extra...). Cause: _plain() calls parent.model_dump(), and pydantic's core serializer does not call IssuerSecret's overridden model_dump. Reproduced: canonical_json(SecurityCertificate(..., parameters={'leak': IssuerSecret(...)})) emits "bases":["Z","X"],"bits":[0,1]. Proposed fix (v1.0.1 serializer, schemas unaffected): either add to IssuerSecret a `@model_serializer` that raises SecretBoundaryError, or make _plain() walk BaseModel fields via getattr instead of model_dump. Lane L works around it in RecordStore (contains_issuer_secret) and log redaction; regression test tests/contracts/test_l_secret_and_serializer.py::test_frozen_canonical_json_refuses_nested_secret is a strict xfail that will flip to XPASS (fail) once fixed, prompting removal of the marker.
